subject: Model shortlist & workload sizing for Novaprime onboarding
body:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novaprime.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff data: model shortlist & initial token estimates

Hi Olivia / Sam,

Thanks again for the chat today — great to align on timelines. As discussed, I’m starting the thread with a first-pass model shortlist and a request for a few inputs we need to finalize sizing for the onboarding plan.

Quick summary:
- Recommended short-list (initial): LLaMA3-13B-q4, Mistral-7B-v0.1, Llama-2-70B (quantized variant for high-quality reranking).
- Typical context length we expect: 2–4k tokens for user prompts + 1–2k tokens for retrieved context depending on the feature set (RAG vs. summarization).
- Ask: can you share monthly message volume by feature (chat, summarization, rerank) and an example of average user session length (messages per session)? Those will determine average tokens/session.

Attached: initial token-volume template (novaprime_token_estimates.xlsx) and a short note on model tradeoffs (novaprime_model_shortlist.pdf).

Next steps:
1) Olivia / Sam — please populate the token estimates tab with expected monthly usage for: chat (conversational UI), document search (reranking), and summarization (batch).
2) Diego and I will convert that into token-month projections and send a capacity/latency recommendation for Dedicated vs Hosted options.

Thanks — I’ll recap in the onboarding kickoff doc once we have volumes.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (555) 213-7780

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novaprime.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samuel Reed <sam.reed@novaprime.io>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff data: model shortlist & initial token estimates

Thanks Monica — attaching a filled high-level usage table (see inline answers below). We can provide more granular numbers after the internal product review on Wednesday.

Inline answers:
- Monthly active users: 12k (targeting 20k in Q4).
- Chat (conversational UI): ~2.5M messages/month. Avg user session: 3 messages.
- Document search / rerank: 150k queries/month, average 4 documents retrieved per query (we usually send 3–5 docs into reranker).
- Summarization (batch jobs): ~40k documents/month, average 600 tokens per doc.

Question: for the reranker, we likely only need short context (top-k passages). Do you recommend using a smaller embedding model plus a stronger reranker, or a single generation model to do reranking + answer synthesis?

Olivia Park
Head of Product
Novaprime
olivia.park@novaprime.io

---

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff data: model shortlist & initial token estimates

Adding initial sizing math based on Olivia's numbers so we can present an ops-ready recommendation.

Assumptions / quick calc (monthly):
- Chat: 2.5M messages/month. Assuming avg prompt 800 tokens + avg generation 600 tokens => 2.5M * 1400 = 3.5B tokens/month.
- Rerank: 150k queries * 4 docs * avg 200 tokens per doc processed by reranker (context) = 120M tokens/month. If we do reranker + synthesis with generation of 200 tokens each => additional 30M tokens.
- Summarization: 40k docs * 600 tokens in * 200 tokens out = 32M tokens in + 8M tokens out = 40M tokens.

Total rough tokens/month: ~3.69B tokens.

Model candidate guidance:
- LLaMA3-13B-q4: lowest cost per-token, good latency for short generations; recommend for chat at standard quality, and reranker pre-processing.
- Mistral-7B-v0.1: strong sequencing efficiency; candidate for chat where we want a better quality/cost balance.
- Llama-2-70B (quant): use as high-quality fallback for complex queries and for synthesis-heavy endpoints.

Sizing recommendation (first 3 months):
- Hosted: Good for initial ramp; use LLaMA3 for chat baseline plus Mistral for a canary. Cache prefixes for repeated system prompt chunks and enable KV cache to reduce generation cost.
- Dedicated: If they expect to exceed 4B tokens/month with low-latency SLOs, propose a small reserved pool (2 x A100 equivalent) for steady chat throughput and a burst pool for heavy rerank/summarization batches.

I will prepare a slide with the math and latency targets for Monday. Marcus — can you confirm approximate qps per GPU for LLaMA3-13B-q4 at 2k context? That will determine concurrency sizing.

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff data: model shortlist & initial token estimates

Diego — quick answers on perf we usually see (ballpark, depends on exact kernel & quant):
- LLaMA3-13B-q4 at 2k context: ~18–25 tokens/sec on an A100-like card with optimized kernels (continuous batching improves throughput; effective qps depends on avg generation length).
- Mistral-7B at 2k context: ~28–35 tokens/sec (more memory efficient).
- Llama-2-70B quant: ~6–10 tokens/sec (higher latency, use for occasional heavy synth tasks).

For 3.5B tokens/month generated across chat, rough GPU-months estimate:
- If we target median generation speed of 22 tokens/sec => ~158k token-hours per GPU-day. Converting is messy but recommend we propose a dedicated pool equivalent to 1.5–2 full GPUs for steady baseline with autoscale to 6 GPUs for spikes.

I’ll put exact perf numbers and a recommended dedicated pool sizing into the deck.

-Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novaprime.io>, Samuel Reed <sam.reed@novaprime.io>

Date: 2026-05-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff data: model shortlist & initial token estimates

Hi Olivia / Sam — thanks for the fast turnaround and the usage numbers.

Next: formal handoff & onboarding plan
1) Implementation owner: Diego Fernandez will lead the technical onboarding (integration, model pinning, KV/prefix cache config).
2) Performance & capacity: Marcus Lin will validate target latency SLOs and finalize dedicated pool sizing for the reserved proposal.
3) CS & success: I will coordinate weekly check-ins and milestone sign-offs; Monica will manage commercial items (deal paperwork / commitments).

Proposed immediate actions for your team:
- Please confirm whether reranking will be an online per-query flow (low-latency) or batched offline (nearline). That changes whether we recommend the embedding + small reranker or a single-generation flow.
- Confirm the percent of queries that need full synthesis vs. simple extractive answers (ballpark ok).

Deliverables we’ll send by Monday: detailed token-month projection (spreadsheet), recommended model routing policy, and a Dedicated capacity proposal with cost estimates.

Attachments: novaprime_token_estimates.xlsx, novaprime_model_shortlist.pdf

If that plan looks good I’ll schedule the weekly 30-minute onboarding sync (same time next week).

Thanks — welcome aboard, excited to get Novaprime live.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
